status: frozen before terminal V19X4, V19BM products, observed invariant scores, lensing, halos, action selection, or gravity fitting
purpose: Commission the posterior decision engine that applies the already-frozen V19BL gates to future region-level I4/I5 features and V19BM controls.

engine_contract.gradient_support: A region passes only when every candidate-required two-component gradient has posterior Mahalanobis significance at least 3.
engine_contract.I4_direction: half-angle of the supported-region mean q_plus/q_cross tensor per draw
engine_contract.I5_activation: mean supported-region bounded baroclinicity per draw
engine_contract.novelty: Apply the frozen 21-coefficient quadratic density control and analytic PRESS independently to every draw; I4 is scored jointly over both tensor components.
engine_contract.leave_one_region_out: Omit each supported region from posterior-median regional features and require the frozen activation/direction stability.
engine_contract.variant_stability: A draw passes only when every registered resolution/aperture variant stays inside the frozen activation and I4 direction tolerances.
engine_contract.posterior_summary: Report activation q05/q16/median/q84/q95, robust detection sigma, and for I4 the wrapped 95-percent axial width.

claim_boundary: V19BN validates decision algebra on manufactured data; it is not an observed source result.
The engine cannot authorize an action until terminal V19X4 and V19BM inputs exist and every V19BL transfer gate passes.
No lensing, halo, action, formula, coupling, or gravity constant is selected.
